value.rationale: The exact law identifies a mathematically natural boundary behavior of signed additive CQR: global shrinkage can turn a nominal interval procedure into an empty-set procedure on a covariate-defined low-width stratum while maintaining exact marginal calibration. The finite-sample frequency and exact conditional profile quantify a practically interpretable failure mode not captured by average interval width or marginal coverage alone.
